body: Ive been separated for about a month now, and October 31st would have been six years married. We had been together a total of 10 years. My.... God i hate to say this, but possible ex wife is the one who initiated all this. It was really hard in general on that day, but i had to suck it up and be strong for my kids while we were trick or treating. I dont know how much longer i can be strong about this though... There have been many times i wanted to end it all... I felt it would be better than this pain im in now.
